---
title: "Samer Lahoud"
---

::: {.hero}
::: {.hero-text}
**Associate Professor and University Research Chair**  
**Faculty of Computer Science, Dalhousie University**  
Head of the Systems Research Cluster · IEEE Senior Member

My research focuses on reliable and secure wireless networks, with emphasis on spectrum and energy efficiency, interference mitigation, anomaly detection, and semantic communication for the Internet of Things.

I am also an external research collaborator with the ROCS team at LISN, Université Paris-Saclay, and coordinate the joint doctoral program between Dalhousie University and Université Paris-Saclay.

I hold a PhD in Computer Science from IMT Atlantique, Rennes and a [habilitation](habilitation.qmd) from Université Paris-Saclay in France for my work on radio resource allocation in cellular networks.
:::

## Spark Lab

::: {.lab-highlight}
::: {.lab-highlight-media}
![](team-summer-24.jpeg)
:::

::: {.lab-highlight-text}
I lead **Spark Lab** at Dalhousie University, where students and collaborators study wireless systems through theory, optimization, measurement, and learning-based methods. Our work connects wireless networking, IoT, security, and intelligent communication systems.

**Current Research Directions**

- Anomaly detection and RF fingerprinting for wireless security
- Low-power wide-area networks for wireless IoT (LoRa, LR-FHSS)
- Wireless coexistence and spectrum monitoring in unlicensed bands
- Semantic and task-oriented communication for IoT
- Wireless digital twins

[Meet the lab](lab.qmd)
:::
:::
